cases.name: satb5_prog
cases.why: FIVE VOICES THAT MOVE — the C-F-G-F progression with all five parts moving. The static chord above cannot exercise the engine's TEMPORAL half (the melodic smoothness, the onset and offset costs, the ordering while the voices move), so the part-aware number must ALSO be measured on a real assignment problem and not on one frozen chord.
